title: Outlay for three AI Centres of Excellence (healthcare, agriculture, sustainable cities)
summary: The Government of India approved a financial outlay of ₹990 crore over five years, 2023-24 to 2027-28, for three Artificial Intelligence Centres of Excellence in healthcare, agriculture and sustainable cities. The centres were first outlined in the Union Budget 2023-24 and inaugurated by the Ministry of Education in October 2024, led by AIIMS Delhi, IIT Delhi, IIT Ropar and IIT Kanpur with industry and startup partners.
purpose: Funding for three AI Centres of Excellence in healthcare, agriculture and sustainable cities.

sources.title: Prime Minister hails the establishment of three AI Centres of Excellence
